headline: Onlookers say botched Texas prison execution is like nothing they have ever seen

members.title: Onlookers say botched Texas prison execution is like nothing they have ever seen
members.lead: Reinaldo Dennes’ execution took more than an hour as workers struggled to find suitable veins An observer of the botched execution of Texas prisoner Reinaldo Dennes this week has said the effects of the lethal injection were like nothing he’d ever seen before. The execution of Dennes at the Huntsville unit of the Texas department of criminal justice took over an hour as the team managing the procedure struggled to find suitable veins in which to administer the injection to the prisoner. members.title: Latest botched execution prompts calls for US moratorium on lethal injections
members.lead: Reinaldo Dennes screamed in pain and took over an hour to die – but Texas officials branded the execution a success A botched execution in Texas on Thursday night that lasted more than an hour and caused the prisoner to scream out, begging the Lord to end his suffering, has led to renewed calls for a nationwide moratorium that would pause all lethal injections. It took 63 minutes for Reinaldo Dennes, 70, to be proclaimed dead in the Huntsville penitentiary. The execution team had struggled to find a vein through which a lethal dose of the sedative pentobarbital could be administered. Continue reading...
